design_council_sources.title: Programming as Theory Building
design_council_sources.kind: Primary paper reproduced in a book appendix
design_council_sources.read_scope: Selected passages from Naur's introduction, Theory Building View, and Program Life, Death, and Revival; not the surrounding editorial or other authors.
design_council_sources.supports: Rationale, connection to the problem domain, and limits of transmitting tacit understanding as documentation.

design_council_sources.title: Structured programming (EWD268)
design_council_sources.supports: Program structure and correctness reasoning; testing is distinct from proof.

design_council_sources.title: A Behavioral Notion of Subtyping
design_council_sources.read_scope: Abstract and introduction, including invariants and history properties
design_council_sources.supports: Behavioral compatibility exceeds compatible signatures. Application to memory adapters is our analogy.

design_council_sources.title: On the Criteria To Be Used in Decomposing Systems into Modules
design_council_sources.supports: Information hiding around difficult or changeable design decisions.

design_council_sources.title: Literate Programming
design_council_sources.kind: Author description of his book and method
design_council_sources.supports: Human-readable explanation linked to program structure. No performance aphorism is attributed to this source.

design_council_sources.title: The UNIX Time-Sharing System
design_council_sources.kind: Bell Labs author archive, 1978 revision of the 1974 paper
design_council_sources.supports: Common I/O and process composition; simplicity and understandability.

design_council_sources.title: Canon TDD
design_council_sources.supports: Incremental concrete tests and feedback; responsibility for quality without prescribing TDD to every practitioner.

design_council_sources.title: Values and Change: Clojure’s approach to Identity and State
design_council_sources.supports: Stable identity associated with distinct values over time. Memory revision and forgetting policy are our design decisions.

design_council_sources.title: Recalling the Giant Leap: Hamilton recollection
design_council_sources.read_scope: Hamilton section; cites a team effort, not sole authorship of Apollo software
design_council_sources.supports: Error recovery and protecting essential work under overload; the proposed memory failure behavior is our application.

design_council_sources.title: Learnable Programming
design_council_sources.supports: Visible program behavior, explanation in context, and exploration.

design_council_note: Documented ideas inform an original design synthesis. No historical meeting, endorsement, personality reconstruction, or proven product outcome is claimed.
